info.title: Laji API
info.description:
## Authentication

This API requires an **Access Token**. To obtain a token:
1. [Send a `POST` request with your email address to the `/api-user` endpoint](https://api.laji.fi/openapi#/API%20user/ApiUsersController_register).
2. An access token will be sent to your email.

Include the token in all requests using the HTTP header: `Authorization: Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN>`

Here on the API frontpage, you can configure the **Access Token**, **Person-Token**, and **Accept-Language** globally using the **Authorize** button below.

---

## Documentation & Resources

- **Additional API documentation:**
  [https://info.laji.fi/en/frontpage/api/api-laji-fi](https://info.laji.fi/en/frontpage/api/api-laji-fi)

- **OpenAPI / Swagger 3.0 specification (machine-readable):**
  [https://api.laji.fi/openapi-json](https://api.laji.fi/openapi-json)

---

## Support

If you have any questions, contact us at **helpdesk@laji.fi**.

operation.summary: Perform aggregate queries (group by) on documents.
operation.description: Aggregates the results of the query based on given "aggregateBy" parameters. Always includes count of rows (count(*)) to the result. Other aggregate functions vary based on the given parameters. Possible aggregate functions are [count, firstLoadDateMin, firstLoadDateMax, securedCount]

parameters.name: aggregateBy
parameters.description: Define fields to aggregate by. Multiple values are seperated by ','.

parameters.name: orderBy
parameters.description: Define what fields to use when sorting results. Defaults to count (desc) and each aggregate by field (asc). Each fieldname given as parameter defaults to ASC - if you want to sort using descending order, add " DESC" to the end of the field name. In addition to aggregateBy fields you can use the following aggregate function names: [count, firstLoadDateMin, firstLoadDateMax, securedCount]. Multiple values are seperated by ','.

parameters.name: onlyCount
parameters.description: Return only count of rows (default) or also additional aggregate function values.

parameters.name: excludeNulls
parameters.description: Include or exclude nulls to result. Will only check nullness of the first aggregateBy field.

parameters.name: pessimisticDateRangeHandling
parameters.description: Value of this parameter affects how oldestRecord and newestRecord are calculated regarding observations reported as date span. False (default): oldest=min(date.begin), newest=max(date.end). True: oldest=min(date.end), newest=max(date.begin).

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Set number of results in one page.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Set current page.

parameters.name: cache
parameters.description: Use cache for this query. Defaults to false.

parameters.name: namedPlaceId
parameters.description: Filter based on URI or Qname identifier of a NamedPlace. Use NamedPlace-API to find identifiers. Multiple values are seperated by ','. When multiple values are given, this is an OR search. API resource: /named-places

parameters.name: namedPlaceTag
parameters.description: Filter based on URI or Qname identifier of MNP.tagEnum (use metadata-api to resolve identifiers) Multiple values are seperated by ','. When multiple values are given, this is an OR search. API resource: /metadata/ranges/MNP.tagEnum

parameters.name: formId
parameters.description: Filter based on URI or Qname identifier of a Vihko Notebook form that was used to report the entry. Multiple values are seperated by ','. When multiple values are given, this is an OR search. API resource: /forms

parameters.name: keyword
parameters.description: Filter using keywords that have been tagged to entries. There are many types of keywods varying from legacy identifiers, project names and IDs, dataset ids, etc.  Will include records with quality issues (normally exluded by default). Multiple values are seperated by ','. When multiple values are given, this is an OR search.

parameters.name: collectionId
parameters.description: Filter based on URI or Qname identifier of collections. Use Collections-API to resolve identifiers. Multiple values are seperated by ','. When multiple values are given, this is an OR search. API resource: /collections

parameters.name: collectionIdExplicit
parameters.description: Filter based on URI or Qname identifier of collections. Use Collections-API to resolve identifiers. Will not include child collections Multiple values are seperated by ','. When multiple values are given, this is an OR search. API resource: /collections

parameters.name: collectionIdNot
parameters.description: Exclude certain collections. Multiple values are seperated by ','. When multiple values are given, this is an OR search. API resource: /collections

parameters.name: collectionIdExplicitNot
parameters.description: Exclude certain collection (only the specified collection, not child collections) Multiple values are seperated by ','. When multiple values are given, this is an OR search. API resource: /collections

parameters.name: includeSubCollections
parameters.description: Defines if collectionId filter should include sub collections of the given collection ids. By default sub collections are included.

parameters.name: sourceId
parameters.description: Filter using identifiers of data sources (information systems). Use InformationSystem-API to resolve identifiers. Multiple values are seperated by ','. When multiple values are given, this is an OR search. API resource: /sources

parameters.name: documentId
parameters.description: Filter using document URIs. Will include records with quality issues (normally exluded by default). Multiple values are seperated by ','. When multiple values are given, this is an OR search.

parameters.name: documentIdPrefix
parameters.description: Filter using document URI prefix. For example prefix of http://id.luomus.fi/JA.1 is luomus:JA.  Will include records with quality issues (normally exluded by default). Multiple values are seperated by ','. When multiple values are given, this is an OR search.

parameters.name: loadedSameOrAfter
parameters.description: Filter using the date data was loaded to Data Warehouse. Format is yyyy-MM-dd or UNIX EPOCH timestamp in seconds. Returns entries loaded later or on the same date/timestamp.

parameters.name: loadedSameOrBefore
parameters.description: Filter using the date data was loaded to Data Warehouse. Format is yyyy-MM-dd or UNIX EPOCH timestamp in seconds. Returns entries loaded before or on the same date/timestamp.

parameters.name: firstLoadedSameOrAfter
parameters.description: Filter using the date data was loaded to Data Warehouse (first load of document). Format is yyyy-MM-dd or UNIX EPOCH timestamp in seconds. Returns entries loaded later or on the same date/timestamp.

parameters.name: firstLoadedSameOrBefore
parameters.description: Filter using the date data was loaded to Data Warehouse (first load of document). Format is yyyy-MM-dd or UNIX EPOCH timestamp in seconds. Returns entries loaded before or on the same date/timestamp.

parameters.name: createdDateYear
parameters.description: Filter using the year the record was created

parameters.name: hasDocumentMedia
parameters.description: Filter only units where parent document has media or doesn't have media.

parameters.name: hasMedia
parameters.description: Filter only records where parent document, gathering or unit has media or none have media.

parameters.name: secureReason
parameters.description: Filter based on secure reasons. Multiple values are seperated by ','. When multiple values are given, this is an OR search.

parameters.name: secureLevel
parameters.description: Filter based on secure level. Multiple values are seperated by ','. When multiple values are given, this is an OR search.

parameters.name: secured
parameters.description: Include only those that are secured or those that are not secured.

parameters.name: qualityIssues
parameters.description: Possible values: NO_ISSUES, BOTH, ONLY_ISSUES. Include records with quality issues (document, gathering or unit issues). Default is NO_ISSUES, but when searching by id (documentId, unitId, keyword) or using annotation endpoint the default is BOTH.

parameters.name: collectionQuality
parameters.description: Filter based on quality rating of collections. Multiple values are seperated by ','. When multiple values are given, this is an OR search.

parameters.name: completeListTaxonId
parameters.description: Show only records where document contains complete list for this higher taxon. For example include only records where all birds or mammals were documented, if they were seens -> something that is not documented was not seen. Use taxon IDs. Multiple values are seperated by ','. When multiple values are given, this is an OR search. API resource: /taxa

parameters.name: completeListType
parameters.description: Show only records where document contains complete list and the list is of this type: URI or Qname identifier of MY.completeListTypeEnum (use metadata-api to resolve identifiers) Multiple values are seperated by ','. When multiple values are given, this is an OR search. API resource: /metadata/ranges/MY.completeListTypeEnum

parameters.name: documentFact
parameters.description: Format is "factName=value;otherFact=value". If value is not given (for example just "factName"), this filter matches all records that have the given fact. If value is a numeric range (for example "factName=-5.0/-1.5"), this filter matches all values where the value is between the range (inclusive). When multiple fact names are given, this is an AND search. For facts that are URIs, you can use full URI or Qname.

parameters.name: partition
parameters.description: You can split search results into partitions. Syntax: '1/5' splits the results to five partitions and returns the first. Useful when downloading large lists of results and you want to split the task into smaller sub-queries.

parameters.name: hasValue
parameters.description: Name (or names) of fields that must be non-null for the occurrence to be included to results. The field must be from level document, gathering or unit (not for example annotation) and must not be an array field. Also, when quering gathering level, unit fields can not be used, etc. When multiple fields are listed, this is an AND search (all must be non-null). Multiple values are seperated by ','.

parameters.name: selfAsEditor
parameters.description: Search for records the user has save or modified. When using this filter, results come from the private warehouse! You  must provide a Person-Token header when using this filter.

parameters.name: Permission-Token
parameters.description: Use granted permissions to search the private warehouse

parameters.name: Person-Token
parameters.description: Provide identify of the user that is using [selfAsEditor, selfAsObserver, selfAsEditorOrObserver, selfIsNotEditorOrObserver] filters.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Alternative way to Accept header to define content type of the response.

200.description: Succesful query. Schema varies based on content-type of the response.

400.description: Parameters were not accepted. Message has details.

429.description: Too many pending requests for the access_token; max is 12

500.description: Service is in unknown erroneous state.
